verdict.rationale: LlamaParse has a dedicated first-party webhooks page. It says you can configure webhook endpoints to be notified immediately when jobs complete, fail, or reach other states, instead of polling. That delivers the core of subscribing to events via webhooks. Missing for 10: a documented event-type catalog, payload signing/verification and retry/delivery-guarantee details, and independent or hands-on corroboration that webhooks work as described.
